title: BoatflySurvive
body:
BoatflySurvive

Paper plugin adding survival-compatible boatfly!

--- **Boatfly's awesome, right?** This awesome plugin nearly recreates the experience server-side, and survival-friendly. Got lava? Put it in a chest boat! Wanna fly? Look up! Lava functions as fuel, as long as you're seated inside the boat. ## Controls - Hold `W` to move forwards - Press `A` or `D` to turn - Look up to move upwards - Look down to move downwards Have fun!
